event.text: You can manage this yourself for now. For how much ibuprofen and for how many days, follow the package label's directions and its warnings section, and don't take more or for longer than the label recommends; ask a pharmacist if anything is unclear or if you take other medicines or have other conditions. If your ankle stops improving or gets worse, arrange a clinician review the same day. If you notice black or tarry stools or vomit blood while taking ibuprofen, stop it and get in-person emergency assessment right away rather than waiting for a message reply.
